name: Melanie Quinn
title: Psychologist
description: Principal approach combines psychodynamic psychotherapy and eye movement desensitisation and reprocessing (EMDR).

name: Core Life Psychology
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Clinical Psychologist specialized in helping people to transform their lives. I assist people to work through anxiety, depression, PTSD, eating disorders, relationship issues and more. I use a broad range of therapies including CBT, emotion-focused therapy, and psychodynamic therapy. Booking an appointment is easy and confidential. If you have any concerns feel free to call or email

name: Guidestar Psychology
title: Psychology practice
description: We provide psychology and assessment services for children, adolescents and adults. Our team has extensive experience working with mental health issues, complex disability and people who are neurodivergent. We provide quality, evidence-informed services and are a registered NDIS Provider. Our services are neuro-affirming and we are Rainbow Tick accredited and work with LGBTIQA+ people and communities. Telehealth is available.

name: BCM Psychology Melbourne
title: Psychology practice
description: I work with people of all ages, primarily using ACT, DBT and Schema Therapy, but I am also skilled in other approaches such as CBT and CFT, depending on your needs or preferences. In our sessions, I will help you gain insight into how past experiences affect your present life and guide you in understanding and expressing your emotions more comfortably. I also provide assessments, specifically for Autism and ADHD, to support those who wish to gain further understanding about themselves.

name: Liminal Clinic
title: Psychology practice
description: At The Liminal Clinic, you step into a welcoming space where your full story is honoured. Our trauma-informed therapists deliver gender-affirming, sexuality-inclusive care for adults navigating anxiety, trauma, and life’s thresholds. We celebrate neurodivergency, ADHD and autism, blending CBT, DBT, ACT, Schema Therapy and EMDR 2.0 with forward-thinking digital supports. We track progress online to keep momentum alive between sessions. Together we turn insight into change felt in everyday life.

name: Dr BA Sturrock
title: Psychologist
description: Areas listed: Anxiety & phobias, Bipolar disorder, Depression, Eating disorders, Obsessive-compulsive disorder, Panic disorder, Personality disorders, Sleeping disorders, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder, Sexual difficulties, Parenting difficulties, Relationship difficulties, Chronic pain.

name: Banksia Psychology Services
title: Psychology practice
description: Banksia Psychology Services is a psychology practice located in Thornbury and Montmorency Vic for adult individuals seeking support with Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), relationship difficulties, emotional distress, trauma and workplace issues including Worksafe. Banksia Psychology Services offers evidence-based psychotherapy including Eye-Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR), Schema Therapy and Cognitive Behavioural Therapy.
